edges.subject: cln5
edges.quote: Loss of cln5 increased the number of autophagosomes suggesting that the basal level of autophagy was increased in cln5 - cells.

edges.quote: Similarly, loss of cln5 increased the amounts of ubiquitin-positive proteins.

edges.subject: HEXA
edges.quote: We also observed an increased amount of intracellular Cln5 in cells lacking the Dictyostelium homolog of the human glycoside hydrolase, hexosaminidase A (HEXA), further supporting the glycoside hydrolase activity of Cln5.

edges.subject: CLN5

edges.subject: ammonium chloride
edges.quote: When cln5 - cells were developed in the presence of the autophagy inhibitor ammonium chloride, the formation of multicellular structures was impaired, and the size of cln5 - slugs was reduced relative to WT slugs.

edges.subject: cln5
edges.quote: These results, coupled with the aberrant autophagic flux observed in cln5 - cells during growth, support a role for Cln5 in autophagy during the Dictyostelium life cycle.
